description: Fetch a user's claimable Merkl rewards and prepare a single claim transaction against the canonical Merkl Distributor (0x3Ef3D8bA38EBe18DB133cEc108f4D14CE00Dd9Ae). Returns a ready-to-sign transaction; if nothing is claimable, returns an empty transactions array with an info-level warning. No on-chain approval needed — the Distributor pulls from its own balance via Merkle proofs.
name: morpho_prepare_claim_rewards
